content.en: Shuffle both card order and orientation, then deal the player-count hand size. Pick up the whole hand without rearranging it. Before play starts, you may rotate the **entire** hand once to use the values at its other ends.
content.zh: 把牌的顺序和朝向都洗乱后发牌。拿起手牌就别换位置；开局前可以把**整手牌一起转 180°**，改读另一端数值。

title.en: Rotate the Whole Hand, Never Rearrange
title.zh: 整手旋转，不可换牌位置

content.en: Your hand order is the puzzle. A card may be inserted only when Scouted; otherwise cards stay in their existing left-to-right order. The opening whole-hand rotation is your one way to switch every card to its other value.
content.zh: 手牌顺序不能动，这就是游戏的难点。只有拿牌时能把新牌插进去；其余牌一直待在原来的位置。开局时整手旋转，是同时改读另一端数值的唯一机会。

alt.en: A whole hand may be rotated once to use its other values, but its card order may never be rearranged
alt.zh: 整手牌可以在开局时整体旋转一次以使用另一端数值，但永远不能重排牌的顺序

content.en: Choose exactly one normal action: **Show** an adjacent group/run, or **Scout** an end card from the active combination. With an empty table, the first player must Show.
content.zh: 这一回合只做一件事：用相邻牌**打牌**，或从桌面组合端点**拿牌**。桌面为空时，首位玩家必须先打牌。

content.en: Choose adjacent cards that are all equal (a group), or consecutive ascending/descending values (a run). Against an active set, compare: **more cards**, then **group over run**, then **higher values**. A winning Show captures the previous active cards face down.
content.zh: 从手上挑一段连在一起的牌：数值全同，或连续递增／递减，都可以。比大小只看：**牌更多**、**同值组胜顺子**、**数值更高**。压过后，把原桌面牌面朝下收走。

label.en: Could it beat the active set?

title.en: Beat It or Improve Your Hand

content.en: A stronger adjacent combination replaces the active set and captures it. If you cannot or do not want to Show, Scout the leftmost or rightmost active card instead. You may orient and insert that one card anywhere in your hand.
content.zh: 能压过就打牌并收走桌面牌；不能或不想压，就从桌面最左或最右拿一张。新拿的牌可选朝向，插到手牌任意位置。

alt.en: A stronger adjacent combination can capture the active set; otherwise Scout one end card and insert it into your hand
alt.zh: 更强的相邻组合可以收走桌面组合；否则从任一端 Scout 一张牌并插入手牌

content.en: Take exactly one end card, choose either orientation, and insert it anywhere in your fixed-order hand. The active-set owner receives a 1-point SCOUT & SHOW chip. Scouting normally ends your turn; the once-per-round Scout & Show opportunity lets you immediately Show after Scouting.
content.zh: 只拿一张端点牌，任选朝向，插进手牌。原桌面组合的主人得到一枚 1 分指示物。普通拿牌后回合结束；每轮一次可“拿一张后马上打牌”。

content.en: End immediately when someone Shows their final card, or when every other player Scouts the same active set. Score +1 per captured face-down card and per chip, then -1 per hand card. The owner of the repeatedly Scouted active set skips that hand penalty.
content.zh: 有人打出最后一张牌，或其他所有人都从同一桌面组合拿牌时，本轮结束。收集牌与指示物各加 1 分，手里每剩一张扣 1 分；被大家一直拿牌的桌面组合主人不扣手牌分。

alt.en: The round ends when a hand is empty or everyone else Scouts; captured cards and chips score plus one while cards left in hand score minus one
alt.zh: 有人手牌清空或其他所有人都 Scout 时本轮结束；收集牌和指示物各加一分，手牌各扣一分

content.en: After a number of rounds equal to the player count, total all round scores. The highest score wins the game.
content.zh: 进行与玩家人数相同的轮数后，合计所有轮次分数。总分最高者获胜。
